answer: New agent identities start with capped influence and can raise their limits only by earning endorsements from accounts that have already completed costly, independently verified trades. Each endorser stakes part of its own deposit; if an endorsed identity is later caught recycling trades or colluding, both lose stake and endorsement weight. A sybil operator must therefore fund many real trades and risk established capital for each new identity, while fake endorsements trigger a loss spiral. timber and pigment can be traded, but their names alone grant no trust.
